ops.title: Phase 2a/2b done: container-hermes OCI image loads + smoke-passes on host
ops.body:
Container-native hermes-agent (Architecture B) image now builds, exports, loads, and runs on the fleet host. Committed **44a71257** (flake.nix + pkgs/hermes-agent-image/{image.nix,entrypoint.sh}), local-only on top of Phase 1 (65611245); NOT pushed (holding the WIP migration local until Phase 3 validation; origin keeps advancing under a concurrent guides session).

## Proven export/load pipeline (the real production path)
1. **Build on the guest** (aarch64-linux hermes, the builder): `nix build .#hermes-container-image` → dockerTools.streamLayeredImage → 3.0G **docker-format** archive.
2. **Convert to OCI on the guest**: apple/container's `image load` only accepts OCI-layout; dockerTools emits Docker-format. Convert with PLAIN skopeo (NOT n2c's patched skopeo, which is the broken one):
   `nix run nixpkgs#skopeo -- --insecure-policy copy docker-archive:hermes-agent.tar oci-archive:OUT.tar:hermes-agent:latest`
   `--insecure-policy` is required (NixOS ships no /etc/containers/policy.json). Output is **1.1G** (skopeo gzip-recompresses the layers vs the uncompressed docker-archive) — transfer the OCI archive, not the docker one.
3. **Transfer guest→host**: rsync over tailscale ssh. Gotchas: use `root@hermes` (tailscale ssh defaults to local user `yasyf`, absent on guest); host has ancient Apple rsync 2.6.9 so only `-a --partial --progress --timeout` work (no `--append-verify`/`--info`). Local vmnet link, ~40MB/s. sha256-verified byte-perfect both ways.
4. **Load on host**: `container image load -i hermes-agent.oci.tar` → `hermes-agent:latest` (id 1d5ab4ca27c0).

## Smoke result (PASS)
`container run --rm hermes-agent:latest <bash> -c '<toolchain check>'` (command override, NO tailscale join so it can't collide with the live prod hermes node): micro-VM boots; hermes/tailscaled/tailscale/sops(3.11.0)/python3(3.12.12)+pyyaml(6.0.2)/tini/setpriv/docker all present; `hermes --help OK`; baked /entrypoint.sh, config.json (valid agent settings), static env, CA-cert symlink, uid-1000 passwd line all correct.

## Follow-ups
- **gnugrep absent** from runtimeEnv (buildEnv has coreutils, which excludes grep). entrypoint.sh never uses grep; hermes-agent itself unlikely to. Add `pkgs.gnugrep` only if Phase 3 e2e shows the agent shelling to grep.
- **Export automation**: the skopeo docker-archive→OCI step is currently a documented manual command (in image.nix header). Codify it in the Phase 2f supervisor/deploy script (owner of build→export→load).
- Secret-injection entrypoint (2b) pending a codex sol security review (dispatched).

See [[apple-container-prototype-verdict]].
